support.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
support.faq.q1: How do I reset my online banking password?
support.faq.a1: Visit the login page and click 'Forgot Password?' to begin the reset process. You will receive an email with instructions within a few minutes.
support.faq.q2: How do I report a lost or stolen card?
support.faq.a2: Call +251 11 000 0000 immediately, available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, to freeze or cancel your card.
support.faq.q3: What are the daily transfer limits?
support.faq.a3: Standard accounts have a Br 50,000 daily transfer limit. Premium accounts may request higher limits at any Geberew Bank branch.
support.faq.q4: How long does it take for a transfer to arrive?
support.faq.a4: Transfers between Geberew Bank accounts are immediate. External bank transfers typically take 1–3 business days.
support.faq.a5: Yes. Geberew Bank S.C. is licensed and regulated by the National Bank of Ethiopia.
